lamps.steady: Fasten the passenger seat belt. The buzzer and lamp turn off once buckled.
lamps.flashing: Blinks if the occupant is an adult and seat belt is not fastened.

lamps.steady: Indicates a system malfunction. Contact an authorized service center immediately.

lamps.steady: Press the clutch pedal to start the engine.
